mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, it signals an acute economic shock that triggers aggressive policy intervention, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 10.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1.0% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO growth rate > 2.0% year-over-year), the economy enters an expansion phase where markets price in imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth rate exceeds 2.0% yoy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units per month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary policy response to an economic downturn, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth rate > 3.0% annualized), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 days as markets price in an impending monetary tightening cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 3.0% annualized.
